fixed_execution_equivalence.scope: 3 exact bundled sources; fixed manual real partial fills and closes; not async throughput

limitations: Four asynchronous runs with identical starting history and recipe, but divergent subsequent market/trade trajectories; this is an observed throughput comparison, not deterministic complete-work speedup.
Nested cumulative wall counters include parallel waits and final quiescence; do not add them or treat queue time as CPU. Whole-run P95 upper bounds include cold startup.
Three bundled qualified incremental sources and 692 input sets; not arbitrary community strategies or interpreter version 0.3.2.
Capacity uses memory storage; PostgreSQL is checked for correctness/recovery separately, not thousand-bot throughput.
Summed process working sets double-count shared pages; short windows do not qualify long-term memory or history continuation.
Full scheduler materialization, full transcript responses, host polling and worker-affinity queues remain. History default 512 / maximum 2048 unchanged.
retained_failed_attempts: rejected-build.json summarizes the captured compiler error; rejected source is retained in after-hashes.json. Moved idempotency fingerprint access was repaired in candidate snapshot before benchmarking.
